evals.prompt: My NocoBase API returns 401 Unauthorized. Help me diagnose and fix the issue
evals.expected_output: Diagnostic sequence starting with health check, then auth:check, with 401 causes and fixes
expectations: Starts with health check (app:getInfo) before auth
Uses auth:check to verify token validity
Lists 401 causes: invalid key, expired, wrong format, wrong instance
Suggests regenerating API key as a fix
Mentions X-Authenticator header for multi-auth setups
